name: Build interactive Rubik's cube web app
instruction: Build an interactive Rubik's cube web app in this directory. Create index.html (plus any JS/CSS files you want) implementing: a 3D or 2D-unfolded cube with all six colored faces, user-triggered face rotations that update the sticker layout, and a scramble + reset control. The page must display the title text 'RUBIK'S CUBE' (or 'Rubik's Cube'). All JavaScript must be syntactically valid.
verifyCmd: f=$(ls index.html *.html 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 1; grep -qi rubik "$f" || exit 1; { grep -qiE '<canvas|WebGL|three' "$f"; } || exit 1; ok=false; { grep -qiE 'rotat|face|sticker' "$f"; } && ok=true; for j in *.js; do [ -e "$j" ] || continue; node --check "$j" || exit 1; { grep -qiE 'rotat|face|sticker' "$j"; } && ok=true; done; $ok || exit 1; P=/tmp/uapv_$$_rubik; node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const h=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");let i=0;for(const m of h.matchAll(/<script([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gi)){if(/\bsrc\s*=/.test(m[1]||""))continue;const c=(m[2]||"").trim();if(!c)continue;i++;fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2]+i+".mjs",c)}' "$f" "$P"; for k in "${P}"*.mjs; do [ -e "$k" ] || continue; node --check "$k" || exit 1; done
